description:
Wall Tuckey Properties are delighted to present 27 Clonuske Green to the market — an exceptional three-bedroom duplex extending to an impressive 121 sq. m., complete with its own designated parking. Beautifully presented and finished with impeccable taste and attention to detail, this stylish home offers an outstanding combination of generous proportions, contemporary design and everyday practicality.

From the moment you enter, the quality of the interiors is immediately apparent. Elegant wainscoting panelling adds character and sophistication, while a striking media wall with integrated electric fire creates an impressive focal point within the living space. Further features include a guest WC and a separate utility room, alongside excellent storage and well-proportioned accommodation throughout. One of the home's standout features is the superb garden, which has been thoughtfully designed by the current owners to feel like a natural extension of the indoor living space. A covered pergola creates a wonderful setting for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing, allowing the garden to be enjoyed throughout much of the year.

Offering approximately 121 sq. m. of beautifully appointed accommodation, 27 Clonuske Green provides the space and comfort more commonly associated with a traditional house, combined with the contemporary appeal and convenience of duplex living. This is a home where considerable thought has gone into both the design and the finer details, resulting in a property that is stylish, spacious and ready for its new owners to simply move in and enjoy.

The property is very close to Balbriggan Town Centre with a wide range of amenities, excellent shopping facilities and a good public transport infrastructure including Dublin Bus, Bus Eireann and Suburban Rail access to Dublin City Centre (c. 45mins). Also within walking distance to Castlemill and Millfield Shopping Centre with a wide range of local amenities on your door step.

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the exceptional proportions, quality of finish and true walk-in condition of this impressive home.
